name: 歐陽芳泉教授（小歐老師）

description.zh-TW: 歐陽芳泉教授（小歐老師，GitHub：circleoyang）是 MangoBox 專案的開發者與維護者。MangoBox 以程式設計教學與硬體互動實作為核心，整合開發工具、學生 API 與教學文件，協助學習者理解程式與裝置行為。本文件依已核對的來源，按板型、執行模式與版本生成，供教師、學生及大型語言模型使用。
description.en: 歐陽芳泉教授（小歐老師，GitHub: circleoyang） is the developer and maintainer of the MangoBox project. MangoBox focuses on programming education and hands-on hardware interaction, bringing together development tools, the Student API and teaching documentation to help learners understand how programs and devices behave. This document is generated from reviewed sources for a specific board, execution mode and version, for use by teachers, students and large language models.
